brief:
Team TS3012: one-screen brief before the final meeting (from TS3012a, TS3012b, TS3012c; full cited brief in brief_TS3012.json)

The team is developing a universal, trendy remote control designed for users under 40.

DECISIONS ALREADY MADE
- The product will be a universal remote control rather than a device-specific one.
    [TS3012b, Speaker A, 00:16:15] "I think we should go for universal, because apparently we're a separate company making separate c remote controls to sell to a lot of diverse people."
- The remote control targets younger consumers under 40 rather than older users.
    [TS3012b, Speaker A, 00:17:41] "Well, we're not we're not targeting older people, we should remember that. Everything we target is under forty, so."
- The remote control case will be made of rubber rather than wood or titanium.
    [TS3012c, Speaker A, 00:22:57] "The case, it will be the material will be rubber, suppose."
- The button shapes will be round for general buttons, triangular for navigation controls, and square for the centre button, over a mild preference for a round centre button from C (industrial designer).
    [TS3012c, Speaker A, 00:27:33] "We'll just take the take the round button, suppose. Uh oh the square button, sorry."
WHAT CHANGED ALONG THE WAY
- In TS3012b, product scope changed from being solely a TV remote control (TS3012a) to a universal remote control.
    [TS3012a, Speaker A, 00:11:32] "The project I got was just for a T_V_ remote control."
    [TS3012b, Speaker A, 00:16:35] "Okay, universal is good. Speech recognition, I think it's very hard, because we're selling across multiple countries. So I think implementing speech recognition is such a small um apparatus, it's"
OPEN ACTIONS AND OWNERS
- All team members will think of a product name for the remote control rather than using a vague serial number. (owner: whole team)
    [TS3012b, Speaker C, 00:39:52] "Shall we all try uh to think about a name?"
- B (user interface designer) and C (industrial designer) will collaborate on the internal and external design before the next meeting. (owners: Speakers B, C)
    [TS3012c, Speaker A, 00:23:27] "apparently you guys, you should work together on the final design, both on internal and external design."
- D (marketing) will conduct a market analysis on how the proposed design will perform in the market. (owner: Speaker D)
    [TS3012c, Speaker A, 00:23:27] "you should probably find out how the product will fall into the market, how uh what's gonna happen with the final design"
UNRESOLVED DISAGREEMENTS
- LCD screen placement: A (project manager) proposed placing the LCD screen lower down so buttons remain on top, while D (marketing), C (industrial designer), and B (user interface designer) preferred it at the top; no placement has been chosen.
    [TS3012b, Speaker A, 00:36:14] "No? It's not that uh it's not the most important function, it's just an extra thing, it just you press the buttons on top, because your finger is on top."
NUMBERS TO KEEP IN MIND
- Target selling price: 25 Euros.
    [TS3012a, Speaker A, 00:12:43] "Selling price, twenty five Euros. That's for you."
- Target production cost: approximately 12.5 Euros.
    [TS3012a, Speaker A, 00:12:43] "The production price, twelve and a half Euros, approximately."
